answer: The atlas counter is kept in vault and umber reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4675 identities would post 1161 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
